onboardingIntro.message: Choose how pages and selected text are translated. You can change this later in Options.

onboardingOfflineDesc.message: Translation runs on your computer, with the Atlas desktop helper and a language pack of about 37 MB each. No text is sent to a web service. Needs the helper installed and running.

onboardingGoogleDesc.message: No key needed, and it covers the most languages. Your text is sent to Google.

onboardingGroqDesc.message: An AI model that translates whole sections in context. Needs your own free key from console.groq.com. Your text is sent to Groq with that key.

onboardingOpenRouterDesc.message: One key for many AI models, and you choose the model. Needs your own key from openrouter.ai. Your text is sent to OpenRouter with that key.

onboardingKeyNote.message: Groq and OpenRouter need your own key. Add it in Options, Services, after you save.

onboardingHelperDesc.message: The helper is a small desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux. It runs the offline engine and keeps the language packs on your computer. Download it from the Atlas releases page, then open it once. Its Offline tab installs language packs.

onboardingSaved.message: Saved. You can close this tab. You can open this guide again from Options, Others.

onboardingSavedKey.message: Saved. Add your key in Options, Services, before this provider can translate. You can close this tab.

onboardingSkipped.message: Skipped. You can close this tab. You can open this guide again from Options, Others.

onboardingOpenDesc.message: Explains the desktop helper and lets you choose the translation provider again.

updateWhatsNew.message: What is new in this version:

onboardingHelperMissing.message: The helper is not running. Start the Atlas Helper, then press Check again. Until a language pair is installed, the next enabled service translates the text.

onboardingHelperNoPacks.message: The helper is running, but no language pair is installed yet. Open the helper, go to its Offline tab, and install the pairs you need. Each pair is about 37 MB.

onboardingHelperPacks.message: Installed language pairs: $PAIRS$. You can install more or remove them in the helper's Offline tab.

onboardingHelperNoEngine.message: The offline engine is not installed yet. Install it from the helper's Offline tab.

lblTranslateWholeParagraphs.message: Translate each paragraph as one text

lblTranslatePageToTargetLanguage.message: Translate the page to the target language

lblAutoTranslateWhenClickingALink.message: Automatically translate when clicking on a link that takes you to the same domain as the current site

lblTranslateSelectedWhenPressTwice.message: Translate selected text when pressing $SHORTCUT_KEY$ twice

lblTranslateTextOverMouseWhenPressTwice.message: Translate the text over the mouse cursor when pressing $SHORTCUT_KEY$ twice

translateClickingOnce.message: Translate the page by clicking once on the button in the address bar. (To see the popup, right-click)

msgToTranslateThisDocument.message: To translate this document $DOC_TYPE$ it is necessary to convert it to HTML

msgSelectServiceConversion.message: Select a service to do this conversion

msgFileLargerThan.message: This service does not support files larger than $FILE_SIZE$

lblHotTranslatedSelectedText.message: Replace selected text with translated text instantly

optionsAddToCustomDictionary.message: Add to custom dictionary (This allows you to skip certain words during web page translation)

msgSelectTargetLanguage.message: Translate websites into this target language

msgSelectTargetLanguageForText.message: Translate selected text into this target language

msgHasBeenUpdated.message: The $EXTENSION_NAME$ extension has been updated to version $EXTENSION_VERSION$.

selectToEnableTranslationService.message: Select the translation services you want to use

useAlternativeService.message: Silently use an alternate translation service if the current target language is not supported by the selected translation service

aboutTagline.message: Translate web pages and selected text in place, with the translation service you choose.

aboutCredits.message: Atlas Translation is a modified fork of TWP - Translate Web Pages, created by [[author]]. Thank you for the original work. The code is released under the [[license]]. See NOTICE.md and LICENSE in the source.

aboutWebDesc.message: Point of sale and ERP that runs on Cloudflare Workers. The Atlas logo and colour theme in this extension come from this project.

aboutAndroidDesc.message: The Atlas Commerce app for Android, built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.

aboutDesktopDesc.message: The Atlas Commerce app for desktop, written in Rust with egui. MIT licensed.

aboutThanks.message: Thank you for using Atlas Translation, and to everyone who helps translate it.

updateCheckDesc.message: Chrome and Edge update only the copies they got from a store. For a copy installed from the GitHub zip, Atlas Translation checks GitHub once a day and tells you when a newer version is out.

updateReloaded.message: Atlas Translation was reloaded while this page was open. Refresh this page to continue.

updateStatusRateLimited.message: GitHub is limiting requests. Atlas Translation will try again later.

updateStatusOffline.message: Could not reach GitHub. Atlas Translation will try again later.

updateBannerHelp.message: Download the zip, unzip it over the old folder, then reload the extension.

translationCaptchaTitle.message: The translation service needs you to confirm you are not a robot.

translationCaptchaText.message: Solve the check below, then press Translate again. If the box stays blank, use "Open in a small window".

msgOpenRouterDescription.message: One key for many AI models, and you choose the model. Add your own key from openrouter.ai. The text you translate is sent to OpenRouter with that key, and from there to the model you choose.

msgGroqDescription.message: An AI model that translates whole sections in context. Add your own key from console.groq.com. The text you translate is sent to Groq with that key.

msgPageSentToGroq.message: Text on this page is sent to Groq to be translated. Groq is an AI service.

msgPageSentToDeepL.message: Text on this page is sent to DeepL to be translated.

msgOfflineNeedsHelper.message: Needs the Atlas Helper and a language pack

msgOfflineDescription.message: Translates on this computer, with no text sent to a web service. The Atlas Helper runs the offline engine and keeps the language packs. Install the helper and a language pack, then click Bind this browser here and allow it in the helper window. If the helper is not running or a pack is missing, the next enabled service translates the text.

msgOfflinePrompt.message: Do you want to link the Atlas Helper to this browser? It is needed for offline translation. Click Bind this browser to link it, then choose Allow in the helper window.

msgOfflineWaiting.message: Waiting for your answer in the Atlas Helper window...

msgOfflineBindRefused.message: The helper window did not allow this browser. Click Bind this browser again and choose Allow.

msgOfflineNoPacksYet.message: Connected. Install a language pack in the helper window.

msgOfflineUpdateHelper.message: This extension needs a newer Atlas Helper. Update Atlas Helper, then try again.

msgOfflineNotRunning.message: The helper is not running. Open the Atlas Helper, then try again.

msgOfflineWrongCode.message: The pairing code is wrong. Copy it again from the helper window.

msgOfflineNoEngine.message: The offline engine is not installed in the helper. Install it from the helper window.

msgOfflineNoPacks.message: No language pack is installed. Install one in the helper window.

msgOfflineCodeFormat.message: The pairing code has 64 letters and digits. Copy it from the helper window.

fileAccessNotice.message: This is a local file. Allow this extension to read file pages in your browser's extension settings, then reload the page.
fileAccessNotice.description: Shown in the popup for a local file (file://) when the browser does not let the extension read it.
